system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> Hey, I’m curious if you have any plans to implement touch swipe features to go back etc. on the macOS desktop app? would 💚 it"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! Thanks for your interest in touch swipe features! We'll pass your feedback along to the team. Keep us posted if you have more thoughts!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Add a greeting and closing for a friendlier, more professional tone."}
